title: Rule-110 Larger-Ring Glider Lift
seed_rule: BC/Sturmian binary prefix using alpha=arccos(-2/3)/(2*pi), lifted to ring lengths 6*F for F in {5,8,13,21,34}; hole track h=n mod 6
neighborhood_coverage: all eight Rule-110 neighborhoods occur in every tested ring
verdict: The length-30 ring is too small and can produce finite-box recurrence. Larger BC/Fibonacci rings show no repeat through 4N steps, maintain nonzero entropy/domain walls, and expose longer diagonal persistence. This supports larger-ring glider diagnostics as the right next dynamical test.
boundary: Finite larger-ring diagnostic only; no Rule-110 universality proof or physical machine proof is claimed.
